items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: A fellow by the name of Kid Green, he used to train all these private fighters around there.

ctx.x: Do you remember the Crescent Saloon? Crescent Tonk, Crescent Saloon? Oh yeah, I remember that.

I remember Savokas, Vic Dubar. I remember Vic Dubar, that's a big dance. That's before they closed the bass. The bass, and schooners used to come in the bass, and I, from Mandeville, a different place, come in there with watermillers, chicken. I heard of many hogs hollering in the sack. They put them hogs in the sack, you know, and bring them in there on the bass. And that time the bass was wide open, all the way to Rampart Street. And they had the giant right there in Howard Avenue Rampart they called Vic Dubar.…
You remember a fellow named Pinky Allen at the old man's saloon?
